<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Media Review">a081d7b283c447107bfa9470ceaad382</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:3692a736834847107bfa9470ceaad3da</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Load Media Data</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
   if (isLoading || newValue == '') {
      return;
   }

	var ga = new GlideAjax("MediaUtilsClient");
	ga.addParam("sysparm_name", "getMediaData");
	ga.addParam("sysparm_media_sys_id", newValue);

	ga.getXMLAnswer(function(response){
		var objResponse = JSON.parse(response);
		g_form.setValue("average_rating", objResponse.average_rating);
		g_form.setValue("synopsis", objResponse.synopsis);
		top.window.document.getElementById("poster_image").src = objResponse.poster_url;
	}
	);

}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-04-09 15:00:56</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>d157f3cf8348c7107bfa9470ceaad3a9</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Load Media Data</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Nowflix" source="x_1960572_nowflix">6071d992830c03107bfa9470ceaad32e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Nowflix">6071d992830c03107bfa9470ceaad32e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_d157f3cf8348c7107bfa9470ceaad3a9</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-04-09 15:06:39</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
